name: Power entry inner layers
question: Which inner layers carry the 60 A power-entry path?
why_now: You asked me to draw the power shapes and their vias and leave the signals to you. The 60 A path from J910 through the ideal-diode FETs, the shunt and the disconnect FETs (VBAT_IN, VBAT_D, VBAT_Q2D) cannot use much of F.Cu: the two busbar areas cover F.Cu at y 61–80 (GND only) and y 90–109 (VBAT_IN only), and the power entry sits at y 73–99, leaving it a 9 mm band between them. So it needs the inner layers, as D14 assumed, and every inner layer it takes is cut out of the VBAT_PROT plane there. That carve was not in the supply-resistance figures so far.

facts.label: Region
facts.value: The three segments sit in x 93.5–158 mm, y 72.5–99.5 mm, between J910 and the disconnect FETs' tabs; VBAT_PROT leaves the FETs' sources at x 161 and must reach U601 (x 78), U701 (x 152) and U801 (x 227)

facts.label: Models
facts.value: power/entry_model.py (the three 60 A segments, layers joined by vias, other nets' pads not cut out: a comparison, a little optimistic) and power/plane_model.py (VBAT_PROT to each switch, both plane layers, with D17 A's north window), 85 °C, full load: 60 A in, 20 A per switch

facts.label: Scale
facts.value: Each switch's on-resistance is 8.9 mΩ typical and channels may differ by up to 7 % (0.6 mΩ); the copper spreads below are a fraction of that

options.name: In2 and In3 both
options.summary: VBAT_IN, VBAT_D and VBAT_Q2D on B.Cu, In2, In3 and the F.Cu band in the power entry; VBAT_PROT on In2 and In3 everywhere else.

images.caption: In2 and In3: the box carries the 60 A path on both layers

measures.label: Total copper loss at full load

costs: U601's supply resistance rises the most; the switches spread a little more

options.name: In2 only
options.summary: The 60 A path on B.Cu, In2 and the F.Cu band; In3 stays a whole VBAT_PROT plane.

images.caption: In2 carries the box; In3 (not drawn) stays whole VBAT_PROT

measures.label: Total copper loss at full load

options.name: Neither (B.Cu and the F.Cu band only)
options.summary: Both VBAT_PROT planes whole; the 60 A path on the outer layers alone.

measures.label: Total copper loss at full load

costs: Nearly 3 W in the power entry's 1 oz copper: a hot spot

recommendation.why: It has the lowest loss by 0.3 W, and the extra spread between the switches (0.20 against 0.16 mΩ) is a third of the switches' own on-resistance tolerance. If even outputs matter more to you than that 0.3 W, B is the choice.

answer: Reply with A, B or C.
